title: Brunch at IHOP – Richmond, KY 2/20/16
description:
In this video, we are having brunch at IHOP located in Richmond, Kentucky. We both ordered water to drink. 
* Tami ordered: Red Velvet Pancakes - (Seasonal Favorite) 4 Red Velvet pancakes topped with cream cheese icing and dusted with powdered sugar $7.79
* Kevin Ordered: Breakfast Sampler – 2 eggs, 2 bacon strips, 2 pork sausage links2 pieces of ham, hash browns & 2 buttermilk pancakes $8.89
* Total (with tax) $17.68
